newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares ease, pause for breath.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares ease, pause for breath.

text.p: Slovenian shares eased 0.9 percent on Thursday on profit-taking after recent rapid gains but traders see market rebounding as selling pressure is subsiding.
"Most shares on the market are following moves in Lek's shares. I think Lek can not fall much lower, so if not tomorrow -- growth will resume next week," Andrej Kavcic of brokerage Ilirika said.
* The 10-share SBI index fell 13.87 points to 1,520.0.
* Overall 13 shares fell, two rose and three were unchanged, while seven were untraded.
* Drug maker Lek's A issue was the most active, falling 2.23 percent to 29,000 tolars on volume of 6,041 shares.
